name: Cruise☆Cruise ~Shoujo no 10nen to Chiisana Yakusoku~
original_name: くる～ず☆クルーズ～少女の10年とちいさな約束～
source:
A young girl fell in love with a young boy and made a promise with him. But as the years passed, he soon forgot about their promise. On his graduation day, Kaoru receives a ticket to a mystery tour aboard the luxury cruise ship Trident, along with his childhood friends Chihiro and Akane. He thought it was suspicious, but he decided to go anyway. When he boards the ship, he meets his classmate Kiriko and notices that he knows most people there.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/08/01/august-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
一名年幼少女爱上了一个少年，并与他许下约定。然而岁月流逝，少年很快便忘记了两人的承诺。毕业当天，薰与青梅竹马千寻和茜一同收到了一张神秘旅行的船票，目的地是豪华游轮“Trident”。尽管觉得事有蹊跷，薰还是决定参加。登船后，他遇见了同学雾子，并发现船上的大多数人自己都认识。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/08/01/august-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
